title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Joao Lucas Da Silva and Gonzalo Bueno in the Lima, originally scheduled for November 12, 2026 at 10:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Joao Lucas Da Silva' if Joao Lucas Da Silva advances against Gonzalo Bueno.

This market will resolve to 'Gonzalo Bueno' if Gonzalo Bueno advances against Joao Lucas Da Silva.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by November 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
